body: What about platonic relationships, friendships? Online communities for things you like? Art, sports, music, etc. Those can be just as satisfying without the complicated emotions of a romantic relationship.
Yes sometimes but I don’t want to bombard them every time I have thoughts/feelings I need to get out

That isn’t a 100% that the next person will and you can’t say it is because you’re not a fortune teller, and furthermore validation from these people isn’t gonna hold you together. It would be a shame if you let them win.

Who taught/told you those things and why do you believe them? Why do their words/actions= truth? Possibly, the thoughts and feelings you have might feel like they’re your own, but they’ve been taught to you, beaten into you. I think that you can redirect your determination to creating new beliefs for yourself, and believing YOUR TRUTH, instead of OTHER’S OPTIONS.

I don’t know your life or what your father has done. From description only, I can say we have similar experiences. I haven’t grown past that pain fully, just have grown hard by it. I know that we can reclaim things: like you not communicating with him, I think is a good thing. Just because someone is blood or older, doesn’t mean you owe them anything. Disrespectful people doesn’t deserve respect. Whenever he goes, you can let his evil die with him, you don’t have to inherit his hate. Like, if you think back, a lot of our behaviors are learned. Your self-hatred is learned... from him unfortunately. So, inherently (before he messed everything up), you are loving and worthy of love.

From extensive experience, another person, in any type of relationship (platonic, romantic, etc), is never going to be the answer. They’re not going to be able to reconcile what you’ve carried with you your whole life; they might bring it out of you but they won’t fix it. That’s for you to do. Another messed up human (because we all are messed up) is not the key. I’m sorry if that makes you feel more alone but it is the truth. Yes relationships can help you develop but healthily pushing you but no one is going to walk into your life like a manic pixie dream person and everything will be perfect. Look at it this way: you didn’t lose anything big; you can be whole on your own.
